input_io: JPEGs preloaded; excludes disk I/O and file output
warmup_scope: constructor, first frame, and warmup times separately reported; lazy capture during warmup is excluded from latency samples
latency_scope: one enqueue through blocking receive, no frames in flight at start
queued_scope: wall time per frame is throughput, not individual frame latency
packet_comparison: selected mode repeats and single/queued, including warmup
